name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 24 2020
information: This competition will be held by Berkeley Cube Club in place of the normally scheduled Berkeley Winter 2020 competition. **Competition Day Timing** * The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. * Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will **not** start more than 20 minutes before the scheduled time. * Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss the last call for that event. In general, the last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. **Team Blind will be held unoficially** For further information, please refer to the "[Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BayAreaSpeedcubin152019#8338-information)" tab.
